name: win-past-client-list
description: Builds a Past Client Reconnect List from your own records, with last contact and last work together, what changed since from linked public sources, a useful reason to write to each, and a short run of 5 to 10 names you pick. Use for "run win-past-client-list", "reconnect with past clients", "who have I lost touch with", "past client list", "former clients who moved jobs", "go back to old clients", "I have not spoken to my clients in a year", part of the Claude Guide for Finding Clients Pack by 90n.
